How does an affiliate tracker know a Paddle sale happened?
Via Paddle webhook events (subscription activated / payment succeeded) or by reconciling against Paddle's reporting API. Trackers with a documented Paddle integration have this wiring pre-built.
What commission rate is typical for SaaS on Paddle?

20–30% recurring is the common band for B2B SaaS. Because Paddle handles subscriptions, recurring commissions renew automatically each billing cycle — verify your tracker claws back commissions on refunds and chargebacks, which Paddle passes through.
Can I run a small Paddle affiliate program with just a spreadsheet?

Under roughly 20 affiliates, yes: issue tracked links yourself and match Paddle's reporting CSV monthly. Above that, cookie attribution and payout math break down — that is the point where a dedicated tracker pays for itself.

guides.h1: How to book an airport transfer in Turkey (step by step)
guides.title: How to Book an Airport Transfer in Turkey (2026): Step by Step | StackPickr
guides.summary: Booking a fixed-price Turkey airport transfer in 6 steps: choose route and vehicle, add flight number and child seats, pay online, meet the driver at arrivals. IST, SAW, AYT.
guides.intro: A pre-booked transfer removes the three classic Turkey airport problems: taxi meters in traffic, price haggling, and finding a car that fits your group and luggage. Here's the exact booking flow, using AvitoVIP Transfer as the worked example.

sections.html: Enter the airport (Istanbul IST, Sabiha Gökçen SAW, or Antalya AYT) and your hotel or address. For return trips, book the hotel→airport leg separately with a pickup time that leaves a traffic buffer — Istanbul traffic to IST can add 30-60 minutes at peak.

Standard sedan fits up to 3 passengers with normal luggage. Families and groups of 4-8 with suitcases should take a minivan — the price difference is small compared to booking two taxis. Business class exists if you want it.
The flight number lets the driver track your actual landing time. If the flight is delayed, pickup shifts automatically — no waiting-fee argument at 2 a.m.
Child seats are bookable in advance. Turkish law requires appropriate restraints for children, and street taxis almost never carry them — this alone justifies pre-booking for families.
The price shown at checkout is final: tolls, parking and reasonable waiting included. You receive a voucher with the meeting-point instructions and the operator's contact.

sections.h: Step 6 — Meet the driver at arrivals
sections.html: After passport control and luggage, walk into the arrivals hall — the driver waits there with a name sign. Show the voucher, load luggage, go. For the return leg, be in the hotel lobby at the agreed pickup time.

sections.h: Fixed price vs taxi meter: the honest comparison
sections.html: A metered taxi can be cheaper on a lucky off-peak run — and significantly more expensive in traffic, at night, or with a driver taking the scenic route. The pre-booked fixed price buys predictability: you know the number before you fly. For first-time visitors, families and late-night arrivals, predictability usually wins.

faqs: How far in advance should I book a Turkey transfer?
At least 24 hours before the flight is comfortable; in high season (June-September) book 2-3 days ahead for minivans.
Is a pre-booked transfer cheaper than a taxi?

Not always the absolute cheapest — but the price is fixed and known in advance, tolls included, with no meter risk in traffic. For families and late arrivals the predictability is worth the difference.
What happens if my flight is delayed?
The driver tracks the flight number and adjusts pickup — reasonable delays don't add fees.
Do I need to pay in advance?
Booking is confirmed online at checkout; the fixed price is locked at that moment.

sections.h: Pricing model: fixed, confirmed at booking
sections.html: Unlike street taxis (meter + traffic + toll arguments) and unlike surge-priced apps, AvitoVIP confirms the full price when you book. Tolls and parking are included; the driver tracks your flight, so reasonable landing delays don't add waiting fees. Child seats are bookable in advance — something street taxis rarely have.

Standard sedan (up to 3 passengers), comfort/business class, and minivans for families and groups up to 7-8 with luggage. Vehicle class is chosen at booking — the price scales with the class, not with the driver's mood.

Pre-booked means pre-booked: this is not an on-demand ride-hailing app for trips inside the city. Coverage is Istanbul and Antalya regions — outside Turkey's tourist airports you'll need local operators. And like any fixed-price service, short hops can cost slightly more than a lucky off-peak taxi — you're buying predictability, not the absolute floor price.
